title: Léo and the Order of the Golden Ladle
description: A boy who can smell and taste the stories hidden in food. A stolen book of magical recipes. A secret order of chefs in 1927 Paris.
coverAlt: Léo and the Order of the Golden Ladle book cover
lead: What if you could taste memories hidden in food?
blurb: Léo Dubois arrives in Paris with nothing but a battered suitcase and a “gift” his mother calls a curse: he can smell stories. Not just ingredients—but secrets. When a simple bowl of soup plunges him into a stranger’s memory of windswept cliffs and salted bread, Léo realizes his nose has unlocked something dangerous.

Welcome to Le Grand Panier, where the kitchen staff aren’t just chefs—they’re guardians of magical recipes that can inspire courage, compel truth, or erase a person’s will entirely. For centuries, the Order of the Golden Ladle has protected these culinary secrets from those who would use them for power.
But someone has stolen their most precious recipe book.

As they chase shadowy villains through Parisian markets, dusty bookstalls, and forgotten underground passages, Léo discovers that his strange ability isn’t a burden—it’s a weapon. And he’ll need it to stop a conspiracy that could control the minds of world leaders.

highlights.title: Paired with Colette, Léo must navigate
items: Poisoned wine at a diplomatic banquet
Secret laboratories hidden in hospital basements
Rooftop infiltrations with nothing but fisherman’s rope
A glass conservatory filled with beautiful, deadly plants

characters.name: Léo Dubois
characters.role: The boy who can smell and taste the stories hidden in food

characters.name: Colette
characters.role: Sharp-tongued niece of the intimidating Chef Antoine

closer: Taste the mystery. Smell the danger. Welcome to the secret world hiding in every kitchen.

title: The Venetian Gambit
description: A poison with no name. A city of masks. A plot that follows Léo and Colette home to Paris.
lead: Summoned to Venice by a cryptic message, Léo and Colette hunt a nameless poison through foggy canals, only to discover the conspiracy leads straight back to their own kitchen.
blurb: For Léo, the boy whose palate can taste the story in every dish, and Colette, the sharp-witted strategist at his side, the peace following their victory is short-lived. A cryptic message arrives from the Venetian chapter of the Order of the Golden Ladle, summoning them to the city of masks and whispers. A powerful politician has been struck by a mysterious culinary ailment—a “flavor of apathy” that is causing him to abandon his duties and endanger the city’s future. Tasked with a mission that has baffled the local masters, Léo and Colette must navigate the foggy canals and black-water markets to uncover a poison that has no name and a conspiracy that runs deeper than the lagoon itself.

Their investigation in Venice reveals a chilling truth: the plot is merely a single thread in a web that leads directly back to Paris. The enemies they thought vanquished still command a network from the shadows, a network of scientific purists known as the Rationalists. This new foe has developed a more insidious weapon—an engineered fungus designed not to control the mind, but to gently, perfectly erase it. When the weapon finds its way into their own kitchen, Léo and Colette realize their sanctuary, Le Grand Panier, has become the next battlefield.

To save their home and the soul of Paris itself, the two young heroes must embark on their most dangerous quest yet. Their hunt for answers will sweep them from the canals of Venice to the treacherous underbelly of Paris, through the secret history of their own Order, and even into a desperate dream of Napoleon’s banquet table, where the secrets of a legendary chef may hold the only key to victory.
closer: In a war fought with flavor and memory, can two apprentices unmask a conspiracy of ghosts before the city’s creative heart is silenced forever?

title: The Sauce of Uncertainty
description: At the 1927 Solvay Conference, a poison of the mind strikes a key physicist, and it tastes of pure uncertainty.
coverAlt: The Sauce of Uncertainty book cover
lead: A new flavor of poison. A new and terrible war.
blurb: Peace has finally settled over Le Grand Panier. Léo Dubois, the boy who can taste stories, has found his place as a saucier, while Colette, the brilliant strategist, helps lead the kitchen. But their hard-won tranquility is shattered by an urgent message from Brussels: a key physicist at the 1927 Solvay Conference has been struck by a mysterious ailment, a perfect “intellectual paralysis.”
The weapon is unlike any they have faced before. It is not a poison of the body, but of the mind, and it carries an impossible flavor Léo can only describe as “pure uncertainty.”

Sent undercover into the vast, impersonal kitchens of the grand Hotel Metropole, Léo and Colette must navigate a world of cold efficiency and professional jealousy to unmask the enemy. Their hunt for the new mastermind of the Rationalists, the mysterious “Sparrowhawk,” will lead them from the glittering halls of Europe’s most important scientific conference to the dusty archives of ancient universities and deep into the primeval forests of the Ardennes.

As they close in on the source of the insidious Sauce of Uncertainty, they uncover a devastating secret that strikes at the very heart of their Order—a lie they have believed for years that is more dangerous than any poison. Now, in a desperate race against time on the Orient Express, they must not only save the future of science but reclaim the soul of their own past.
The Sauce of Uncertainty is a thrilling new adventure in the world of The Golden Ladle Chronicles, blending culinary magic, historical espionage, and the unbreakable bonds of found family.
closer: In a world of complex formulas, the most powerful recipe of all is a dash of courage and a simple taste of the truth.

title: The Scent of Secrets
description: Paris’s most popular new perfume smells like a summer day and tastes like a lie. To stop it, Léo must trust a boy who believes only in molecules.
coverAlt: The Scent of Secrets book cover
lead: A flavor can tell a story. But what happens when a scent tells a lie?
blurb: The battle against the Sparrowhawk is over, but for Léo Dubois and the members of the Order of the Golden Ladle, the victory feels hollow. They are guarding a devastating secret: the Order’s most sacred recipe book is a soulless forgery, and the real one is still in the hands of their enemy. Le Grand Panier, once a bustling sanctuary, has become a fortress of simmering anxiety.

When Léo, the Order’s gifted “Reader” with a palate that can taste memories and emotions, is sent on a simple errand to procure a bottle of Paris’s most popular new perfume, Écho de Lavande, he discovers a new and terrifying threat. The perfume smells of a beautiful, honest summer day, but it tastes of a cold, sterile, and perfectly structured lie—the unmistakable signature of a Rationalist weapon.

To unravel the conspiracy, Léo and his brilliant strategist partner, Colette, must seek the help of Julien Clément, the perfume’s creator and a scientific “Nose” of prodigious talent. But Julien trusts only in formulas and molecules; he scoffs at Léo’s talk of tasting stories and lies. Forced into a reluctant alliance, the boy who reads emotions and the boy who reads chemicals must learn to trust each other to fight a common enemy.

Their investigation reveals the Sparrowhawk’s most sophisticated plot yet: a two-part weapon that uses a primer scent to “marinate the senses” for a flavor-based attack, designed to erase a person’s will to disagree. The trail of lies leads them from the back alleys of Paris to the sun-drenched flower fields of Grasse, and into a deadly decoy in the masked, secret-filled canals of Venice.

characters.name: Julien Clément
characters.role: A scientific “Nose” who trusts only formulas and molecules

closer: When the enemy is a master of the perfect forgery, how can you trust your senses to tell you what is real?

title: The Queen’s Gambit
description: Five young apprentices. Three dangerous trials. A royal banquet that’s really a trap.
coverAlt: The Queen’s Gambit — Apprentices of Highwind Volume 1 book cover
lead: In a kingdom where armies are watched and secrets are weapons, the greatest threats are met not by knights in shining armor, but by five young apprentices chosen to move in the shadows.
blurb: This single volume contains the first three trials of their apprenticeship. Their journey begins with a desperate race against time, carrying a secret message from their Queen to the reclusive Elven Court through a forest that listens and remembers. Next, they must venture into the blighted southern territories to investigate a creeping sickness that corrupts the very land and magic itself, only to discover they are being stalked by a dark reflection of their own group—ruthless, skilled, and with twisted powers of their own.

Finally, the threat comes home. A grand banquet is not a celebration, but a trap set by the Queen to expose a conspiracy festering within Highwind’s own walls. The apprentices are plunged into a game of espionage and hidden passages, where the most dangerous enemies may be the ones smiling from across the hall.

As they face down corrupted magic, shadowy counterparts, and traitors in their midst, the five friends must learn that the Queen’s plan is a dangerous gambit, and they are the key players. To survive, they must forge their individual talents into an unbreakable bond, because the shadows are gathering, and they are the only light standing against them.

highlights.title: Three trials in one volume
items: A race to the reclusive Elven Court through a forest that listens and remembers
A creeping sickness in the blighted south, and a dark reflection of the apprentices themselves
A royal banquet set as a trap for traitors inside Highwind’s walls

characters.name: Rowan
characters.role: The peerless scout, with her falcon Ashwing, seeing what others miss

characters.name: Lyra
characters.role: The gifted mage, whose connection to magic is her greatest strength and deepest fear

characters.name: Brinna
characters.role: The stoic blacksmith, resilient as the steel she forges

characters.name: Corwin
characters.role: The knight-in-training, whose heart is braver than his sword arm

characters.name: Tobin
characters.role: The clever cook, whose sharpest weapon may be a well-timed pastry

title: The Fractured Crown
description: An ancient forge, a sabotaged tournament, a stolen relic, and a spy with divided loyalties, all part of one sinister design.
lead: The apprentices of Highwind have faced the shadows. Now, the shadows are learning their names.
blurb: In this second collection of epic adventures, the threats to the kingdom deepen, moving from the wild frontiers to the very heart of the castle. Old alliances are tested and new, dangerous players are revealed as each of the young heroes is confronted with a trial that will change them forever.

A slumbering power, a sabotaged tournament, a stolen relic, and a divided foe—the apprentices discover every threat is connected, part of a grander, more sinister design. They must evolve beyond their training, for the battles ahead will test not just their skills, but the very nature of their souls.

highlights.title: Four trials that change everything
items: Brinna awakens an ancient subterranean forge and a legendary suit of armor that forces a choice between creation and a world-shattering power
Corwin organizes the Crown of Trials tournament and learns that true leadership means trusting his team
Ashwing, the loyal falcon, witnesses the theft of a sacred royal artifact and must warn the others through a silent language of found objects
Behind enemy lines, a young spy named Cadell weighs his loyalty against a growing admiration for his enemies

closer: Deeper lore, more complex alliances, and impossible choices that will change the kingdom forever.

title: Highwind’s Unseen Gears
description: A clumsy blacksmith’s apprentice discovers the secret network of young operatives who really keep Highwind Castle running, and the traitor hiding among them.
lead: Years before Queen Aveline dispatched her elite apprentices on magical quests, a different kind of power kept Highwind Castle running.
blurb: For Hadwick of Oakhaven, a clumsy new blacksmith’s apprentice, the castle is a bewildering storm of impossible tasks, stern masters, and constant chaos. He’s just trying to survive his first week without causing a major incident. But amidst the clamor, he starts to notice the impossible: a jammed gate opens as if by magic, a missing tool appears just in time, and strange chalk marks materialize on stone walls, only to vanish moments later.

He soon discovers the truth: the real magic that holds Highwind together isn’t wielded by knights or nobles. It’s in the hands of the Apprentice Network, a clandestine society of young operatives who use a web of secret passages, coded signals, and carefully orchestrated “accidents” to keep the castle from collapsing under its own weight.

But the Network has a problem. A series of malicious disruptions threatens to sabotage a royal banquet and expose their secrets. As Hadwick is drawn into this shadow war, he realizes the greatest threat may not be a new enemy, but a traitor hiding in plain sight—a fellow apprentice using the Network’s own methods against it.

characters.name: The Apprentice Network
characters.role: A secret society of young operatives working in the castle’s shadows

closer: The boy who’s only ever caused accidents must now learn to create them on purpose.

title: Westvale: Where Weird Happens
description: Fourteen stories. One very strange school. Zero normal days.
coverAlt: Westvale: Where Weird Happens book cover
lead: Welcome to Westvale Middle School. Please ignore the tentacles in the cafeteria.
blurb: At Westvale, weird isn’t just possible — it’s policy. And the students have learned to roll with it. Mostly.
If you loved the absurdity of Sideways Stories from Wayside School or the creepy fun of Goosebumps, buckle up. Westvale cranks both dials to eleven.
Funny, fast-paced, and just the right amount of spooky — Westvale Tales is the series kids finish in one sitting and immediately hand to their best friend.

highlights.title: Open these pages to find
items: 🐹 A covert ops team led by a hamster moving through the vents
🔒 A hungry locker that eats secrets and spits out chaos
⏰ A detention room where kids are trapped across time
🔬 A science fair project that accidentally opens a black hole on Main Street
🤖 An ancient AI addicted to alien reality TV

closer: Fourteen stories. One very strange school. Zero normal days.

title: Westvale: Even Weirder
description: A three-nostriled gym coach, memory-flavored cafeteria goo, and a library book that traps you inside the story.
lead: Westvale is back—and it’s even weirder.
blurb: The school looks normal from the outside. But step inside and every pop quiz and hallway rumor hides a story stranger than the last, from haunted plays to spectral photographers.
But the students of Westvale are learning that sometimes the scariest thing isn’t a monster—it’s losing the weirdness that makes them who they are.

highlights.title: Step inside and you’ll find
items: A gym coach with three nostrils whose dodgeballs hum with alien energy
Cafeteria goo that tastes like your happiest memories… or your darkest fears
A library book that doesn’t just tell a story—it traps you inside it
A candy fundraiser with reality-warping side effects
A lake creature and the mysterious agents determined to make Westvale “normal”

closer: Hilarious, spooky, and heartfelt tales of middle school mayhem with a supernatural twist.

title: The Möbius Unit: Quantum Chaos and Other Adventures
description: Five brilliant middle schoolers run a secret STEM agency beneath their school. One novel and three novellas of gadgets, humor, and real science.
coverAlt: The Möbius Unit: Quantum Chaos and Other Adventures book cover
lead: Welcome to a world where science is the ultimate superpower.
blurb: Meet the Möbius Unit: five ordinary middle schoolers with extraordinary minds, hidden beneath Hillview Middle School. When global threats arise that baffle the grown-ups, these brainy heroes, guided by the mysterious Oracle and their subtly sharp librarian Ms. Finch, step up to save the day.
This action-packed collection brings together the thrilling debut novel and three pulse-pounding novellas, packed with high-tech gadgets, laugh-out-loud humor, and mind-bending scientific challenges.

contents.title: The Möbius Unit: Quantum Chaos
contents.text: A reclusive rogue genius, Dr. Aris Cipher, unleashes the “Quantum Glitch,” a rapidly escalating fractal anomaly threatening to unravel global infrastructure and reboot the world to his twisted design.

contents.title: The Day Ms. Finch Saved the World
contents.text: When time slows down for everyone except Ms. Finch, the unflappable librarian must fix a fundamental imbalance in spacetime, armed with nothing but her wits and a very special e-reader.

contents.title: The Material Menace
contents.text: A single microscopic Morph-Mite hitches a ride back from Paris, and soon Hillview is plagued by bouncy floors, sticky doors, and worse. Chloe and Kai must outsmart the nano-tech terrors.

contents.title: The Propulsive Predicament
contents.text: Zara’s new Grav-Coils keep sending her wheelchair spinning. As “The Shifting Skies” threatens air travel worldwide, the team must use Newton’s Laws of Motion to solve the problem.

highlights.title: Why readers love the Möbius Unit
items: Brainy heroes with heart, using their STEM talents to solve big problems
Drones, holograms, secret HQs, and cutting-edge gadgets
Real concepts from physics, engineering, AI, and chemistry, wrapped in adventure
Fast-paced plots, witty dialogue, and unexpected twists
Five friends who collaborate, learn, and grow

closer: Perfect for readers who love secret agent stories, futuristic tech, and heroes who use their brains.
